title: Protein protein Interactions of NarL with NarG, SsrB, and FNR Proteins in Salmonella Typhimurium: A Comparative Analysis.
authors: Sahoo, Pravas Ranjan; Kumar, Ajay; Pashupathi, M; Sahoo, Jyochhna Rani; Behera, Parthasarathi; Saxena, Meeta
one_liner_zh: 该文通过实验和分子对接比较了转录因子NarL与NarG、SsrB、FNR蛋白间的互作强度，虽涉及TF-蛋白互作但非TF-DNA结合，方法以湿实验为主、仅含简单对接，对TF-DNA互作建模借鉴有限。
abstract: Salmonella Typhimurium (STM) is the leading cause of gastroenteritis in humans and animals worldwide. Nitrate anaerobic regulator L (NarL), a global transcription factor of STM, interacts with different binding partners and thereby influences bacterial colonization and virulence under anaerobic conditions. The present study was conducted with the objective of elucidating the interactions of the NarL protein with its binding partners, such as nitrate reductase G (NarG), Secretion system regulator transcriptional activator (SsrB), and Fumarate and nitrate regulator (Fnr). Therefore, NarL, NarG, SsrB, and FNR proteins were first expressed in the prokaryotic system and the binding of NarL with NarG, SsrB, and FNR was evaluated through microtitre plate assay, dot blot, blot overlay assay, gold nanoparticle based protein binding assay, and circular dichroism spectroscopy. The NarL-NarG binding interaction was found to be significantly stronger (P < 0.05) than NarL-SsrB, followed by the NarL-FNR interaction. Binding interactions were further validated with isothermal titration calorimetry, and it was observed that the NarL-NarG interaction was exothermic with a DeltaG of -16.4 kcal/mol, while the binding of NarL-SsrB was endothermic with a DeltaG of 7.6 kcal/mol. However, FNR protein did not show any gain or release of free energy during interaction with NarL protein. Further, the molecular docking showed a higher binding energy score between NarL-NarG complex than NarL-SsrB and NarL-FNR protein complex. These results provide basic information that would facilitate the development of novel therapeutics against STM by targeting these specific interactions.
abstract_zh: 鼠伤寒沙门氏菌（Salmonella Typhimurium, STM）是全球人类和动物胃肠炎的主要病原体。硝酸盐厌氧调控因子L（NarL）是STM的一种全局转录因子，通过与不同的结合伙伴相互作用，从而在厌氧条件下影响细菌的定植和毒力。本研究旨在阐明NarL蛋白与其结合伙伴（如硝酸还原酶G（NarG）、分泌系统调控转录激活因子（SsrB）和延胡索酸与硝酸盐调控因子（Fnr））之间的相互作用。因此，首先在原核系统中表达了NarL、NarG、SsrB和FNR蛋白，并通过微量滴定板测定、斑点印迹、印迹覆盖测定、基于金纳米颗粒的蛋白结合测定以及圆二色光谱法评估了NarL与NarG、SsrB和FNR的结合情况。结果发现，NarL-NarG的结合相互作用显著强于（P < 0.05）NarL-SsrB，其次是NarL-FNR相互作用。结合相互作用进一步通过等温滴定量热法验证，观察到NarL-NarG相互作用为放热反应，ΔG为-16.4 kcal/mol，而NarL-SsrB的结合为吸热反应，ΔG为7.6 kcal/mol。然而，FNR蛋白在与NarL蛋白相互作用过程中未表现出自由能的增加或释放。此外，分子对接显示NarL-NarG复合物的结合能得分高于NarL-SsrB和NarL-FNR蛋白复合物。这些结果提供了基础信息，有助于通过靶向这些特定相互作用来开发针对STM的新型治疗策略。
